title: Revealing Trends in Datasets from the 2022 ACL and EMNLP Conferences

bias_targets.methodology: Quantifying the 'language gap' by categorizing and counting the distribution of English, non-English monolingual, and multilingual datasets to evaluate the linguistic representation in NLP research.
Analyzing author affiliations to measure the concentration of dataset curation among specific top-tier academic institutions and industry labs, highlighting resource disparities.
Surveying and cataloging newly introduced NLP datasets (e.g., French CrowS-Pairs, holistic descriptor datasets) that are built to measure social bias in masked language models and dialog systems.
Identifying datasets in the survey (e.g., MT-GenEval) that specifically evaluate gender accuracy and counterfactual contexts in machine translation models.
